description: LND (Lightning Network Daemon) is a complete implementation of a Bitcoin Lightning Network node. This template defaults to Neutrino mode, a lightweight built-in light client, so it can run standalone without requiring a full Bitcoin Core node — swap the command to --bitcoin.node=bitcoind (plus --bitcoind.* options) to use the Bitcoin Core template in this list instead.
name: lnd
title: LND (Lightning Network Daemon)
